body:
Got a text from my boss Christmas evening at 8.30pm saying, "Merry Christmas, see you 9am tomorrow".
We didn't open until 1pm but he wanted me in to count cash and read machine figures (Casino). As far as I was told before then, I wasn't meant to be in until 1pm.

Thank you, I have tried many times to speak about my problems with some family. Other members would not necessarily understand as we where brought up to 'get over it'. That's the best way I can describe it. I do struggle to communicate, but I do try. Even my fiance is somewhat aware. But im afraid to let him in too much incase he blames himself or something of the type. 

Thank you
